services.name: Johnson County MED-ACT
services.evidence: We provide 9-1-1 response to over 600,000 citizens across 479 square miles and operate dual clinician ambulances from 19 fixed ambulance stations ... Response to medical emergencies in Johnson County is a coordinated system consisting of response by MED-ACT ambulances, often augmented by local fire department personnel

20091.page_note: Johnson County MED-ACT runs the 911 ambulances across Johnson County; city fire departments respond alongside it but do not run their own ambulances.
20091.second_source: https://johnsoncountypost.com/2026/03/29/6-people-hospitalized-95th-metcalf-crash-282788/ (2026-03, Overland Park: 'two Med-Act Battalion Chiefs and six ambulances responded'); KBEMS licence lookup (KEMSIS, pulled 2026-09-11): JOHNSON COUNTY MED ACT is the only Ground Ambulance licence based in the county

services.name: Leavenworth County EMS
services.evidence: EMS is a department within county government and provides services to the entire county. We hold an exclusive provider-ship, which means all calls for an ambulance, which originate within the geographic boundaries of Leavenworth, require our permission to respond. Our daily system consists of five Advanced Life Support ambulances
services.vintage: 2026 (page undated, read live 2026-10-22; licence active 2026-09-11, no sign of change)

20103.page_note: Leavenworth County EMS is the 911 ambulance provider for Leavenworth County, including the cities of Leavenworth and Lansing. Since May 2026 Fort Leavenworth has run its own ambulance service on the post, and who now operates it has not yet been confirmed.
20103.second_source: KBEMS licence lookup (KEMSIS, pulled 2026-09-11): LEAVENWORTH COUNTY EMS is the only Ground Ambulance licence based in the county; https://www.army.mil/article/292055/fort_leavenworth_transitions_to_in_house_emergency_services_ambulance_transport (2026: Fort Leavenworth in-house EMS from May 1, 2026, third-party EMS contract from June; county EMS no longer serves the post)

services.name: Butler County EMS

services.evidence: Since the 1970's, Butler County Emergency Medical Service has served the citizens and visitors of Kansas's largest county. ... Today, BCEMS responds to over 7,200 requests for service utilizing five ambulances 24-hours a day, 7-day a week. Our headquarters are located in El Dorado with outlying stations in Andover, Augusta, and Rose Hill.
